name: Patagonia Capilene Cool Daily Shirt
description: This versatile performance knit is designed for use on the trail or on the water. It provides built-in odor control and moisture-wicking properties, all made from recycled polyester.

name: Tentree TreeBlend Classic T-Shirt
description: Crafted from a signature blend of recycled polyester, organic cotton, and TENCEL lyocell. This incredibly soft, lightweight tee plants ten trees for every purchase, making it a true staple for the eco-conscious wardrobe.

name: Pact Organic Cotton Essential Sweatpant
description: Experience ultimate comfort with these sweatpants made entirely from GOTS-certified organic cotton in a Fair Trade factory. They feature a relaxed fit and incredibly soft brushed interior perfect for lounging or running errands.

name: Outerknown Blanket Shirt
description: Arguably the coziest shirt ever made, constructed from heavyweight organic cotton twill. It stands up to the elements while offering a remarkably soft touch and rugged durability for any adventure.

name: Allbirds Men's Sea Tee
description: Woven with a unique blend of eucalyptus tree fiber and marine-sourced crab shell fibers, this tee boasts natural odor reduction and breathability. Its classic fit and premium feel elevate your everyday basics while protecting the oceans.

name: Eileen Fisher Organic Linen Classic Collar Shirt
description: A timeless, crisp button-down shirt tailored from yarn-dyed organic linen. This garment embodies slow fashion, offering a breezy, lightweight texture that only gets softer and more beautiful with each wash.
